# pai lessons

Review-gated lessons for agents

```
pai lessons <command>
```

A short curated memory layer, one Markdown file per lesson in the PAI home. Candidates only reach agents once approved.

```sh
pai lessons list --state candidate
pai lessons propose
pai lessons approve my-lesson
```

See also: `pai memory`

### pai lessons list

List lessons

```
pai lessons list [options]
```

Lists lessons, optionally filtered by state or project.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--state S` | string | — | candidate, approved, rejected or superseded |
| `--project P` | string | — | Project slug or global |
| `--json` | flag | — | Print JSON |

```sh
pai lessons list
pai lessons list --state approved --project global
```

### pai lessons show

Show one lesson

```
pai lessons show ID
```

Prints a lesson with its frontmatter fields and body.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Lesson id (its file name without .md) |

```sh
pai lessons show my-lesson
```

### pai lessons add

Add a candidate lesson

```
pai lessons add [options]
```

Creates a lesson in the candidate state; approve it after review.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--title T` | string | — | Short title |
| `--kind K` | string | — | workflow, correction, debugging, gotcha, convention |
| `--applies-when W` | string | — | One sentence: when the lesson applies |
| `--project P` | string | — | Project slug (default: global) |
| `--body B` | string | — | The lesson in 1-5 sentences |

```sh
pai lessons add --title "Run tsc first" --kind workflow --applies-when "before committing"
```

### pai lessons approve

Approve a candidate

```
pai lessons approve ID
```

Approve a candidate. Only candidates can be approved.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Lesson id (its file name without .md) |

```sh
pai lessons approve my-lesson
```

### pai lessons reject

Reject a candidate

```
pai lessons reject ID
```

Reject a candidate. Only candidates can be rejectd.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Lesson id (its file name without .md) |

```sh
pai lessons reject my-lesson
```

### pai lessons promote

Promote an approved lesson to a project skill

```
pai lessons promote ID [options]
```

Writes the lesson as a SKILL.md under <project>/.claude/skills/<slug>/ (and with --agents also <project>/.agents/skills/<slug>/). Refuses to overwrite an existing skill unless --force.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Lesson id (its file name without .md) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project DIR` | string | — | Project directory (default: this directory) |
| `--force` | flag | — | Overwrite an existing SKILL.md |
| `--agents` | flag | — | Also write under .agents/skills |

```sh
pai lessons promote my-lesson --project ~/code/app --agents
```

### pai lessons supersede

Replace an approved lesson by another approved one

```
pai lessons supersede ID [options]
```

Marks ID superseded; the replacement given with --by must exist and be approved.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Lesson id (its file name without .md) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--by ID2` | string | — | The approved lesson that replaces it |

```sh
pai lessons supersede old-lesson --by new-lesson
```

### pai lessons propose

Add candidates from a transcript

```
pai lessons propose [TRANSCRIPT] [options]
```

Finds user messages that correct the assistant and adds each as a candidate to review. By default a regex heuristic (no model call); with --draft a model reads the user messages and drafts titled lessons with an applies-when and the quoted evidence (at most 10).

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TRANSCRIPT` | no | Transcript file (default: newest of this directory) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--draft` | flag | — | Draft candidates with a model (running local model, else the routed default) instead of the regex heuristic |
| `--local-only` | flag | — | With --draft: fail rather than fall back to the cloud model when no local model is running |

```sh
pai lessons propose
pai lessons propose ./session.jsonl
pai lessons propose --draft --dry-run
```
